correctness.rationale: The proof gives an exact support inequality for every product state and classifies all equality cases. Jensen plus weighted arithmetic-geometric mean reproduces the known optimum. Equality for any optimizer confines every product component to the same phase orbit; the \(P_0\) Jensen equality then forces the first \(n\) Fourier moments to vanish, which uniquely determines the orbit mixture on all Dicke matrix entries. The optimizer has rank \(n+1\), while a uniform roots-of-unity ensemble supplies \(n+1\) product terms. The universal claim is analytic rather than extrapolated from finite tests.

value.rationale: The direct prior literature already uses this family as a benchmark relating geometric and relative-entropy entanglement, but leaves optimizer geometry implicit. Establishing uniqueness for a rank-two family is nontrivial because general uniqueness is automatic only under stronger hypotheses. The exact product length \(n+1\) converts a continuous twirl into a provably minimal finite preparation and exposes the Fourier structure responsible for the optimizer.
